Requirement Description: Formula length: at least 1024 characters long as measured in OpenDocument interchange format
Suggested Test: Parse a 1024+ character formula; verify accepted.

Requirement Description: At least 30 parameters per function when prototype permits parameter list
Suggested Test: Call function with 30 parameters; verify accepted.

Requirement Description: Permit strings of ASCII characters up to 32767 (2^15-1) characters
Support at least 7 nesting levels of functions
Suggested Test: Nest 7 levels of functions; verify accepted.
Evaluate IRR(values); verify internal rate of return.
Evaluate NPV(rate,values); verify net present value.
Evaluate TODAY(); verify current date serial.
Evaluate TRIM(" a  b "); verify "a b".

Requirement Description: References containing more than one area need not be evaluated
Suggested Test: Reference with multiple areas; may return error or partial result.

Requirement Description: Inline arrays need not be implemented
Suggested Test: Use {1,2} inline array; may return error.

Requirement Description: Complex numbers need not be implemented
Suggested Test: Use COMPLEX function; may return error.

Requirement Description: Reference union operator (~) need not be implemented

Suggested Test: Use criteria in database functions; verify parsed correctly.
Parse numeric literals including decimals, scientific notation; verify.
Parse string literals with quote escaping; verify.

Requirement Description: Functions and Function Parameters syntax supported
Suggested Test: Call functions with various argument counts; verify.

Requirement Description: Nonstandard Function Names recognized as errors
Suggested Test: Use unknown function name; verify error result.
Use cell and range references; verify resolution.
Define and use named expression; verify.
Use error constants (#N/A, etc.); verify propagation.
Insert whitespace in formula; verify identical result.
Convert number/date/logical to text; verify result.
Convert text to number; verify result.
Convert reference to scalar value; verify result.
Convert number to logical; verify result.

Requirement Description: Error propagation when expression returns Error
Suggested Test: Pass error as argument; verify error propagates.
